release_test.step: Our signed APT and YUM repository installs and upgrades sendmock

install.stable:
sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://shibbirweb.github.io/sendmock/packages/sendmock.gpg | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/sendmock.gpg > /dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/sendmock.gpg] https://shibbirweb.github.io/sendmock/packages/apt stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sendmock.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y sendmock
install.beta:

release_test.step: makepkg builds sendmock-bin and pacman installs it

installs.prepare:
pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed base-devel git sudo unzip
useradd -m aur-builder
echo 'aur-builder ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/aur-builder

install.stable: sudo -u aur-builder bash -c 'cd /tmp && git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/sendmock-bin.git && cd sendmock-bin && makepkg -si --noconfirm'
install.beta: sudo -u aur-builder bash -c 'cd /tmp && git clone https://aur.archlinux.org/sendmock-beta-bin.git && cd sendmock-beta-bin && makepkg -si --noconfirm'
